method: OpenStreetMap building footprint way 649374332, name 'ニュートリノターゲットステーション棟' / 'Neutrino Target Station Building' (building=industrial, amenity=laboratory), used verbatim. The T2K NIM paper's Figure 2 labels the target station as the point where the primary beamline ends and the secondary beamline (target, horns, decay volume) begins.
name: J-PARC neutrino target station building
notes: Anchor point for geometry:j-parc-neutrino-direction-line's bearing calculation and for the near-detector-hall distance check.

summary.plain: The building at J-PARC where the primary proton beamline ends: a graphite target inside three magnetic horns turns the proton beam into a beam of secondary pions.
